long_biography.plain_text:
Raised in a Cologne-area trading family, Geiss trained in wholesale and retail and learned commercial operations in his parents' business. He and his brother Michael then founded Uncle Sam, developing bodybuilding apparel into a prominent German fitness-fashion label. The profitable sale of their interests became the financial base for his later investments.

After moving to Monaco, Geiss spread capital across property, start-ups and fashion, returning to apparel with Roberto Geissini. He and his wife Carmen also turned their family life into a television business through Die Geissens, first broadcast in 2011 and later produced through their own company. The mix of property deals, consumer branding and television production now defines a business career that began with specialist sportswear.
